entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A person with an account who can place and track their own orders.
entities.retention: 5 years after last order activity, then deleted or anonymised (gap-closed 16, Revenue Code envelope)

key_fields.name: customer_email
key_fields.lawful_basis: PDPA s24 contract; s19 consent for marketing
key_fields.masking: domain only in admin lists; redacted in logs

key_fields.name: customer_phone
key_fields.masking: last 4 digits in admin lists; redacted in logs

key_fields.name: customer_name
key_fields.masking: none in order context; redacted in non-order logs

key_fields.name: password
key_fields.masking: one-way hash only; never displayed, logged or returned

entities.name: Session
entities.description: An authenticated session represented by a short-lived access token and a rotating refresh token.

key_fields.name: session_tokens
key_fields.masking: hashed or opaque; never logged or displayed

transitions.trigger: the access token passes its 15-minute lifetime
the customer presents a valid refresh token

transitions.compensating_action: invalidate the whole session family and require a fresh login

transitions.trigger: the customer logs out or a replayed refresh token is detected
transitions.compensating_action: none required - revocation is the safe terminal state

entities.name: Cart
entities.description: A customer's working basket before checkout. Holds no stock.

entities.name: Stock
entities.description: Per-product inventory tracked as three quantities: available, reserved and sold.
entities.retention: stock adjustment history retained 5 years with the audit record (gap-closed 16)

transitions.trigger: a customer confirms an order for the quantity
the 30-minute reservation expires, or payment fails, or the order is cancelled before payment

transitions.compensating_action: an admin cancellation before packing returns the units to available and opens a manual refund under RULE-PAYMENT-03

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A confirmed purchase with a frozen price snapshot, a status timeline and a human-readable order number.
entities.retention: 5 years (financial and dispute evidence, gap-closed 16, Revenue Code)

key_fields.name: shipping_address
key_fields.masking: snapshotted into the order; redacted in non-order logs

transitions.compensating_action: an admin cancellation before packing releases the stock and opens a manual refund under RULE-PAYMENT-03

transitions.trigger: the provider reports a declined payment
transitions.compensating_action: release the reserved stock under RULE-STOCK-03

transitions.trigger: no payment result arrives before the reservation expires
transitions.compensating_action: release the reserved stock under RULE-STOCK-03
release the reserved stock under RULE-STOCK-03

transitions.trigger: an admin starts picking the goods
transitions.compensating_action: none - the transition is internal and carries no external effect

transitions.trigger: an admin cancels before packing, with a reason
transitions.compensating_action: release the sold stock to available and record a manual refund under RULE-PAYMENT-03

transitions.trigger: an admin dispatches with a tracking number
transitions.compensating_action: no in-MVP compensation - returns are out of scope (gap-closed 6.5)
no in-MVP compensation - returns are out of scope (gap-closed 6.5)

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A mock-provider payment attempt against one order, identified by a provider event id.

key_fields.name: amount_thb
key_fields.masking: shown to the owning customer and to the back office only

transitions.compensating_action: manual refund recorded with an idempotency key under RULE-PAYMENT-03

transitions.trigger: no provider result arrives in time

glossary.definition: Units moved from available to reserved at order confirm, released after 30 minutes if payment does not complete.

surface_form: ราคา ณ เวลาที่สั่งซื้อ
glossary.definition: The price, product name and address frozen onto an order at creation so later catalogue edits cannot change it.
The mock payment provider re-sending a callback with an event id already processed; must not apply twice.

surface_form: ดูได้เฉพาะของตัวเอง
glossary.definition: A customer may read only records they own; enforced on every customer-facing read.
